package.name: trainit_perception
package.description: TrainIt perception: detectors that turn the camera contract (image + depth + intrinsics) into the perception contract (vision_msgs/Detection3DArray). Each detector is a pure function, so the Setup Assistant's live tuner and the runtime node execute the same code. It also ranks: the published ORDER of the detections is the candidate ranking, computed from closed-form perception terms a person can argue with (ADR-0014, ADR-0016, ADR-0017). The grasp FACE is the pluggable shape and it declares what configures it, so a new face family is one class and no second repo (ADR-0018). The configuration vocabulary -- methods, rules, terms, faces, parameter schema, version floors -- is exported by trainit_perception.vocabulary.export(); the Setup Assistant commits a snapshot of it and never imports this package while it generates (ADR-0021). Since 0.6.0 it is also a GRASP PROVIDER: SurfaceGrasp (tp.surface_grasp) turns the measured surface into ranked, constrained trainit_interfaces/GraspCandidate[] with explicit rejection codes (ADR-0026, vNext M4). Since 0.7.0 SurfaceGrasp can segment from an external segmenter's instance image (instance_topic), filters regions by a workspace polygon (eligibility), and a scripted provider (tp.scripted) serves mock product tests.
